scan.title: Got a message you’re unsure about?
scan.placeholder: Open the message, press and hold it, choose “Copy”, then paste it here
scan.image_link: Or upload a screenshot of the message
scan.privacy_tip: Before you send: remove your name, account number and any verification code from the text.
scan.submit_empty: Paste the message first so we can check it
scan.loading_title: Reading the message and looking for signs…
scan.loading_note: It usually takes less than 15 seconds. Don’t close the page.
scan.disclaimer: The result is an AI estimate and can’t guarantee the message is safe. We didn’t save your message.
scan.insufficient_body: The text is short, with no link, request or sender name, so we can’t tell if it’s a scam.
scan.insufficient_hint: Paste the full message, or upload a screenshot that shows the sender.
scan.guest_body: To protect the service from abuse, each account gets 5 checks a day. An account is free and takes a minute.
scan.guest_note: The game and the guides work without an account.
scan.guest_cta: Create an account and check your message
scan.guest_cta2: I have an account, log in
scan.limit_title: You’ve used your 5 checks for today
scan.limit_body: You get 5 new checks at midnight. Until then, don’t tap any link you’re unsure about.
scan.limit_hint: Try spotting it yourself: the 3 signs in “Learn about scams”.
scan.limit_cta2: Read the 3 signs of a scam
scan.image_types: We accept PNG, JPG and WEBP images.

errors.NETWORK: You’re offline. Your answers are saved on your device, and we’ll continue as soon as you’re back online.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_QUESTIONS: We couldn’t set up the round right now. Try another type or come back in a bit.
errors.SESSION_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: This round was already counted. Start a new challenge.
errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find this round. Start a new challenge.
errors.CLAIM_NOT_ALLOWED: We couldn’t add this round’s points to your account. It was already saved, or it’s more than a day old.
errors.SCAN_FAILED: We couldn’t check the message right now. The checking service didn’t respond. This didn’t use up a check, and your message wasn’t saved.
errors.SCAN_FAILED_HINT: Try again in a minute. If it’s urgent, don’t tap the link until you’re sure.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image is {size} MB. The limit is 5.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE_HINT: Take a screenshot of just the message, or crop the image and upload it again.
errors.IMAGE_TYPE: We don’t accept this file type. Upload a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.
errors.TEXT_TOO_SHORT: The text is short. Paste the full message.
errors.LOGIN_FAILED: The email or password is wrong. Check them, or tap “Forgot password?”.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email already has an account. Log in with it instead of creating a new one.
errors.PASSWORD_SHORT: The password is too short. Use 8 characters or more.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong on our side, and none of your data was lost. Try again in a bit.
errors.PASSWORD_MISMATCH: The two passwords don’t match. Type it again.
errors.RESET_LINK_INVALID: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
